# Shiu Drosophila brain model provenance

Upstream role: published executable dynamics reference used to define the engineering LIF reconstruction.

Pinned upstream commit:
`91bdd1e7dcf193f3e7ca5a8933497fcef63b7960`

Upstream repository:

FLY-01 does not represent this code or its constants as a native MaleCNS v1.0 simulator. The accepted FULL model applies Shiu-derived engineering dynamics to a different structural connectome.

The upstream MIT license text is retained in `third_party/licenses/Shiu_Drosophila_brain_model_MIT.txt`.
